commands.label: Find file
commands.description: Opens the fuzzy file finder for the project; type part of a file name and press Enter.
examples: SPC f f, type ordsvc, Enter → opens OrderService.java
SPC SPC → opens the same finder from the root menu
commands.rationale: Doom Emacs and LazyVim find project files with SPC SPC; LazyVim also uses SPC f f, and VSpaceCode uses SPC p f.

commands.label: Open recent file
commands.description: Lists recently opened files, most recent first; pick one to open it again.
examples: SPC f r, type test → reopens a test file you had open earlier
commands.rationale: VSpaceCode, Doom Emacs and LazyVim all use SPC f r for recent files.

vscode.note: VS Code has no picker for recent files only; Quick Open lists the editor history first and searches all files once a query is typed.

commands.label: Reveal file in tree
commands.description: Shows the current file in the project file tree and selects it.
examples: SPC f p → the tree scrolls to the current file and selects it
commands.rationale: Conventions differ (Doom Emacs uses SPC o P, and VSpaceCode's SPC f t only toggles the tree), so the key sits in the File group: p for the project tree.
